title: Gap and BroSis Give Precollege Students the Experience of a Lifetime
description: Imagine getting a one-on-one critique from renowned fashion designer Zac Posen while still in high school — that's what participants in this program experience.

title: FIT's MFA Programs Excel in U.S. News Rankings
description: FIT's School of Graduate Studies earned significant recognition in the 2026 U.S. News and World Report rankings, with multiple programs placing among national graduate institutions.

title: 'Transformative' Harnisch Gift Expands Special Collections and Fashion History Timeline
description: A donation from philanthropist Ruth Ann Harnisch via the Harnisch Foundation supports two scholarly initiatives, strengthening FIT's archival and academic resources in fashion history.

title: FIT and Polimoda Renew 40-Year Partnership, Continuing Global Study Abroad Opportunities
description: FIT and Polimoda in Florence, Italy celebrate 40 years of collaboration by renewing their partnership agreement, continuing international opportunities for design students.

title: FIT and Columbia Work Together on a New Sustainable Fiber
description: FIT and Columbia University received a grant from the Bezos Earth Fund to develop sustainable fiber technology, advancing environmental solutions in textile innovation.
